 Both require `results/reference_selection.json`, matching selected `results/summary.json`, and a completed native Athena CT case. A short real pilot cannot qualify as the XMM reference. A missing or stale prerequisite refuses output, preserving any existing report.
+
+`--check` also verifies any present canonical movies. For both absolute and radial-contrast products it calls `audit_artifacts.verify_movie_receipt(..., expected_case=selection['animation_case'], require_gif=True)`: exact source/output hashes, actual frame epochs, physical UTC, completed source case and no marker extrapolation must match. Existing stale or unprovenanced movies refuse output instead of being embedded. Absent products remain explicitly pending. An explicit animation case may differ from the quantitative reference, and both names are displayed. No rendering runs inside the builder.
@@

Its plan, consumed helper/geometry/GTI hashes and each used case's probe/configuration/statistics/accepted trace/status hashes must match. Each used case must also pass the recorded formulation/provenance qualification, and domain pairs must pass the independent registered experiment-identity guard. The selected latitude bound and physical inputs are checked against the actual controls. A narrower domain needs its own passing comparison against the completed widest reference; retaining the widest registered domain makes no claim of narrower eligibility. Missing or failed initial-condition and outer-extent checks appear in the headline and conclusion. These baseline controls do not establish untested fine-grid temporal accuracy.
+
+Every numerical/exposure pass and every physical comparison labeled qualified additionally requires the independent formulation/provenance and experiment-identity gates. Raw `passed` alone is insufficient; `qualified_pass`/`qualified_for_sensitivity` are checked. The outer pair, CFL, radial count and extent come from the prospective plan. Actual failed extended-domain attempts are separately read from controller/configuration/trace/log evidence and remain visible after a later control changes or passes. The two failed3.125AU cases never become completed scientific results; any passing2.3→2.85AU control qualifies only that registered extent/CFL.
+
+Numerical qualification is explicitly separate from empirical accuracy in the lead and conclusion. Native metrics are accepted only for the selected case with current probe/configuration/statistics/metadata hashes and matching paired TSV residuals/correlation. Fixed STA hourly speed-threshold timing is derived without phase fitting. CCMC/selected PN incident-flux ratios come from the actual selected-clock summary, with no coarse value substituted for a fine case. The separate coarse cone checks retain their own scope. Density scenarios derive from the two training-instrument density medians; half/double temperature controls are broad scenarios, not those medians or statistical bounds.
+
+The averaging table shows actual MOS1, MOS2 and PN GTI durations/means separately, plus the continuous103491s published-pointing mean.
